Tesseract.js, self-hosted so a letter's photo is read on the visitor's device and never uploaded.
Downloaded with `npm pack` on 2026-10-01. Files are unmodified copies from the tarballs.

tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js
  tesseract.js 5.1.1 (dist/), Apache-2.0: LICENSE-tesseract.js.md.
  Bundled third-party notices (MIT / BSD-3-Clause): tesseract.min.js.LICENSE.txt, worker.min.js.LICENSE.txt.
  The .map files named in their last line are not shipped (only browser dev tools ask for them).

core/tesseract-core-simd-lstm.wasm.js, core/tesseract-core-lstm.wasm.js
  tesseract.js-core 5.1.1, Apache-2.0: core/LICENSE-tesseract.js-core.
  LSTM-only builds with the WebAssembly embedded. The worker picks the SIMD one when the browser supports
  WebAssembly SIMD and the plain one otherwise, so each visitor downloads one of the two.

lang/eng.traineddata.gz, lang/hin.traineddata.gz
  @tesseract.js-data/eng 1.0.0 and @tesseract.js-data/hin 1.0.0, folder 4.0.0_best_int: the integer
  versions of Google's tessdata_best models (https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best), Apache-2.0.
  4.0.0_best_int is the variant tesseract.js uses by default. For English it is 3.0 MB against 10.9 MB for the
  float model; for Hindi the two are the same size.

Loaded lazily by site/assets/js/ocr.js, only when a photo or a scanned PDF is chosen:
  createWorker(langs, 1 /* LSTM */, { workerPath: "/vendor/tesseract/worker.min.js",
    corePath: "/vendor/tesseract/core", langPath: "/vendor/tesseract/lang", workerBlobURL: false, gzip: true })
